map_note: 222,531 of the 23,451,219 mail-ballot requests in the Election Lab's data have no district, so request figures on the map add up to 23,228,688. 180,960 of the 6,662,914 ballots cast in the Election Lab's data (2.7%) have no state Assembly district and appear only in the statewide total.
